lines.t: When someone has done you wrong
Do not let it linger on
For if you let resentment stay, it can turn your heart away
So settle matters quickly, bring them before the Lord
Choose the path of mercy and let grace restore
The first stitch to mend a rent is the simple phrase, I'm sorry
Leave your adversary a gift, lay it at their door
See peace with a humble spirit, let compassion lead you through
Blessed are the poor in spirit, let forgiveness start with You
You see, this is what had happened to me
A story the Lord helped me see
I forgave my precious sister and he set my spirit free
Now I won't keep looking backward, I place her in his hands
I pray that love will find its way and heal what time could not mend

The weight has lifted off me
This sin cannot take root
My soul is now at peace
I bless my sister, praying someday we'll meet
And maybe at His table, He will save her a seat
So praise the Lord forever, give Him all the glory
He helped me overcome, and write a different story
